severity_definition: fraction of 68 features unavailable per observation
operational_missing_value_representation: unavailable feature replaced by its frozen training-derived median before frozen-model inference
random_branch: exactly round(severity*68) distinct feature positions selected independently for every row
important_branch: top round(severity*68) features globally masked in every row; ranking derived only from frozen XGBoost model feature_importances_
important_feature_ranking: mean normalized frozen-model importance across binary and multiclass XGBoost models
